verses.original: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִנִּ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה לְנַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יָדְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hin·nî·aḥ Yah·weh lə·nas·sō·wṯ bām ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ’êṯ kāl- mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: These are the nations that the LORD left to test all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars in Canaan
verses.literalPt: Estas são as nações que Jeová deixou, para por elas provar a Israel, isto é, a quantos não tiveram experiência de todas as guerras de Canaã.

verses.original: רַ֗ק לְמַ֙עַן֙ דַּ֚עַת דֹּר֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְלַמְּדָ֖ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥ק אֲשֶׁר־ לְפָנִ֖ים לֹ֥א יְדָעֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: raq lə·ma·‘an da·‘aṯ dō·rō·wṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·lam·mə·ḏām mil·ḥā·māh raq ’ă·šer- lə·p̄ā·nîm lō yə·ḏā·‘ūm
verses.literal: if only . . . to teach warfare to the subsequent generations of Israel especially to those who had not known it formerly
verses.literalPt: Isto fez tão somente para que as gerações dos filhos de Israel tivessem experiência de guerra, sendo nela instruídos unicamente os que dantes não tinham essa experiência.

verses.original: חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וְכָל־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַצִּ֣ידֹנִ֔י וְהַ֣חִוִּ֔י יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַ֣ר הַלְּבָנ֑וֹן מֵהַר֙ בַּ֣עַל חֶרְמ֔וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·mê·šeṯ sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm wə·ḵāl hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·haṣ·ṣî·ḏō·nî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî yō·šêḇ har hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn mê·har ba·‘al ḥer·mō·wn ‘aḏ lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ
verses.literal: the five rulers of the Philistines all the Canaanites the Sidonians and the Hivites who lived in the mountains of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath
verses.literalPt: Estas são os cinco régulos dos filisteus, e todos os cananeus, e os sidônios, e os heveus que habitavam no monte Líbano, desde o monte Baal-Hermom até à entrada de Hamate.

verses.original: וַֽיִּהְי֕וּ לְנַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָדַ֗עַת הֲיִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū lə·nas·sō·wṯ bām ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lā·ḏa·‘aṯ hă·yiš·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: These nations were left to test - the Israelites to find out whether they would keep the commandments of the LORD which He had given their fathers through Moses
verses.literalPt: Estes serviram para provar a Israel, a fim de saber se eles obedeceriam aos mandamentos de Jeová, que ele ordenou aos seus pais por intermédio de Moisés.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יָשְׁב֖וּ בְּקֶ֣רֶב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י הַחִתִּ֤י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl yā·šə·ḇū bə·qe·reḇ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: Thus the Israelites . . . continued to live among the Canaanites Hittites Amorites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel habitaram no meio dos cananeus, dos heteus, dos amorreus, dos ferezeus, dos heveus e dos jebuseus.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֨וּ אֶת־ בְּנוֹתֵיהֶ֤ם לָהֶם֙ לְנָשִׁ֔ים וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם נָתְנ֣וּ לִבְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯê·hem lā·hem lə·nā·šîm wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯê·hem nā·ṯə·nū liḇ·nê·hem way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: And they took the daughters of these people . . . in marriage gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods
verses.literalPt: Tomaram por mulheres as filhas deles, deram suas filhas aos filhos dos mesmos e serviram aos seus deuses.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶת־ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיִּשְׁכְּח֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·yiš·kə·ḥū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ā·lîm wə·’eṯ- hā·’ă·šê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . did evil in the sight of the LORD they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel fizeram o mal à vista de Jeová, e esqueceram-se de Jeová, seu Deus, servindo os Baalins e as Aserotes.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵ֗ם בְּיַד֙ כּוּשַׁ֣ן רִשְׁעָתַ֔יִם מֶ֖לֶךְ אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרָ֑יִם וַיַּעַבְד֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yim·kə·rêm bə·yaḏ kū·šan riš·‘ā·ṯa·yim me·leḵ ’ă·ram na·hă·rā·yim way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- kū·šan riš·‘ā·ṯa·yim šə·mō·neh šā·nîm
verses.literal: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram-naharaim and the Israelites . . . served him eight years
verses.literalPt: Pelo que se acendeu a ira de Jeová contra Israel, e os entregou nas mãos de Cusã-Risataim, rei de Mesopotâmia; os filhos de Israel serviram a Cusã-Risataim oito anos.

verses.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּ֨קֶם יְהוָ֥ה מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיּֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם אֵ֚ת עָתְנִיאֵ֣ל בֶּן־ קְנַ֔ז אֲחִ֥י כָלֵ֖ב הַקָּטֹ֥ן מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·‘ă·qū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- Yah·weh way·yā·qem Yah·weh mō·wō·šî·a‘ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·wō·šî·‘êm ’êṯ ‘ā·ṯə·nî·’êl ben- qə·naz ’ă·ḥî ḵā·lêḇ haq·qā·ṭōn mim·men·nū
verses.literal: But when the Israelites . . . cried out to the LORD He raised up Othniel son of Caleb’s younger . . . brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando os filhos de Israel clamaram a Jeová, suscitou-lhes ele um salvador que os livrou, a saber, Otniel filho de Quenaz, irmão mais moço de Calebe.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י עָלָ֥יו רֽוּחַ־ יְהוָה֮ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֵּצֵא֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ אֶת־ כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתַ֖יִם מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַתָּ֣עָז יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ- Yah·weh way·yiš·pōṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·ṣê lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·yit·tên Yah·weh bə·yā·ḏōw ’eṯ- kū·šan riš·‘ā·ṯa·yim me·leḵ ’ă·rām wat·tā·‘āz yā·ḏōw ‘al kū·šan riš·‘ā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him and he became Israel’s judge and went out to war And the LORD delivered Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram into the hand of Othniel who prevailed . . . against him
verses.literalPt: O Espírito de Jeová veio sobre ele, e ele julgou a Israel; saiu a pelejar, e Jeová entregou-lhe nas mãos a Cusã-Risataim, rei de Mesopotâmia, contra o qual prevaleceu a sua mão.

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָאָ֖רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֖מָת עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ קְנַֽז׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·qōṭ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh way·yā·māṯ ‘ā·ṯə·nî·’êl ben- qə·naz
verses.literal: So the land had rest for forty years until Othniel son of Kenaz died
verses.literalPt: A terra teve descanso quarenta anos. Otniel, filho de Quenaz, morreu.

verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְחַזֵּ֨ק יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ עֶגְל֤וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָב֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ל כִּֽי־ עָשׂ֥וּ אֶת־ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·si·p̄ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·ḥaz·zêq Yah·weh ’eṯ- ‘eḡ·lō·wn me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al kî- ‘ā·śū ’eṯ- hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Once again the Israelites . . . did evil in the sight of the LORD So He gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel because . . . they had done evil in the sight of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então, tornaram os filhos de Israel a fazer o mal à vista de Jeová; e Jeová fortaleceu a Eglom, rei de Moabe, contra Israel, porque haviam feito o mal à sua vista.

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף אֵלָ֔יו אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּֽירְשׁ֖וּ אֶת־ עִ֥יר הַתְּמָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn wa·‘ă·mā·lêq way·yê·leḵ way·yaḵ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yî·rə·šū ’eṯ- ‘îr hat·tə·mā·rîm
verses.literal: After enlisting the Ammonites . . . and Amalekites to join forces with him Eglon attacked and defeated Israel taking possession of the City of Palms
verses.literalPt: Eglom, unindo a si os filhos de Amom e de Amaleque, foi-se e feriu a Israel. Apoderaram-se da cidade das Palmeiras,

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְד֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ עֶגְל֣וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָ֔ב שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ‘eḡ·lō·wn me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ šə·mō·w·neh ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . served Eglon king of Moab eighteen . . . years
verses.literalPt: e os filhos de Israel serviram a Eglom, rei de Moabe, dezoito anos.

verses.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ אֶל־ יְהוָה֒ וַיָּקֶם֩ יְהוָ֨ה לָהֶ֜ם מוֹשִׁ֗יעַ אֶת־ אֵה֤וּד בֶּן־ גֵּרָא֙ בֶּן־ הַיְמִינִ֔י אִ֥ישׁ אִטֵּ֖ר יַד־ יְמִינ֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בְּיָדוֹ֙ מִנְחָ֔ה לְעֶגְל֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·‘ă·qū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- Yah·weh way·yā·qem Yah·weh lā·hem mō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- ’ê·hūḏ ben- gê·rā ben- hay·mî·nî ’îš ’iṭ·ṭêr yaḏ- yə·mî·nōw way·yiš·lə·ḥū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·yā·ḏōw min·ḥāh lə·‘eḡ·lō·wn me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: And again they . . . cried out to the LORD and He raised up Ehud son of Gera a left-handed . . . . . . Benjamite . . . . . . as their deliverer So they sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando os filhos de Israel clamaram a Jeová, suscitou-lhes ele um salvador, Eúde, filho de Gera, benjamita, homem canhoto. Por ele enviaram os filhos de Israel tributo a Eglom, rei de Moabe.

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ֩ ל֨וֹ אֵה֜וּד חֶ֗רֶב וְלָ֛הּ שְׁנֵ֥י פֵי֖וֹת גֹּ֣מֶד אָרְכָּ֑הּ וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אוֹתָהּ֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לְמַדָּ֔יו עַ֖ל יֶ֥רֶךְ יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lōw ’ê·hūḏ ḥe·reḇ wə·lāh šə·nê p̄ê·yō·wṯ gō·meḏ ’ā·rə·kāh way·yaḥ·gōr ’ō·w·ṯāh mit·ta·ḥaṯ lə·mad·dāw ‘al ye·reḵ yə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: Now Ehud had made for himself a double-edged . . . sword a cubit long He strapped it to his right thigh under his cloak
verses.literalPt: Eúde, fazendo para si um punhal de dois gumes, dum côvado de comprido, cingiu-o debaixo do vestido à sua coxa direita.

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְעֶגְל֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֑ב וְעֶגְל֕וֹן אִ֥ישׁ בָּרִ֖יא מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rêḇ ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh lə·‘eḡ·lō·wn me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ wə·‘eḡ·lō·wn ’îš bā·rî mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: and brought the tribute to Eglon king of Moab who was an obese . . . man
verses.literalPt: Apresentou o tributo a Eglom, rei de Moabe; ora, Eglom era em extremo gordo.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּלָּ֔ה לְהַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וַיְשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּנְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer kil·lāh lə·haq·rîḇ ’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām nō·śə·’ê ham·min·ḥāh
verses.literal: After Ehud had finished presenting the tribute he ushered out those who had carried it
verses.literalPt: Eúde despediu a gente que trouxera o tributo, depois de o ter apresentado.

verses.original: וְה֣וּא שָׁ֗ב מִן־ הַפְּסִילִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶת־ הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דְּבַר־ סֵ֥תֶר לִ֛י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הָ֔ס וַיֵּֽצְאוּ֙ מֵֽעָלָ֔יו כָּל־ הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū šāḇ min- hap·pə·sî·lîm ’ă·šer ’eṯ- hag·gil·gāl way·yō·mer də·ḇar- sê·ṯer lî ’ê·le·ḵā ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer hās way·yê·ṣə·’ū mê·‘ā·lāw kāl- hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: But upon reaching the idols near Gilgal he himself turned back and said I have a secret . . . message for you O king Silence said the king and all his attendants . . . . . . left him
verses.literalPt: Porém ele mesmo voltou das pedras esculpidas que estavam junto a Gilgal e disse: Tenho que dizer-te, ó rei, uma palavra em segredo. Disse o rei: Silêncio! Todos os que lhe assistiam saíram da sua presença.

verses.original: וְאֵה֣וּד׀ בָּ֣א אֵלָ֗יו וְהֽוּא־ יֹ֠שֵׁב בַּעֲלִיַּ֨ת הַמְּקֵרָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֙ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵה֔וּד דְּבַר־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִ֖י אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַיָּ֖קָם מֵעַ֥ל הַכִּסֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·hūḏ bā ’ê·lāw wə·hū- yō·šêḇ ba·‘ă·lî·yaṯ ham·mə·qê·rāh ’ă·šer- lōw lə·ḇad·dōw way·yō·mer ’ê·hūḏ də·ḇar- ’ĕ·lō·hîm lî ’ê·le·ḵā way·yā·qām mê·‘al hak·kis·sê
verses.literal: Then Ehud approached him . . . while he was sitting alone in the coolness of his upper room - I have a word from God for you Ehud said and the king rose from his seat
verses.literalPt: Eúde entrou a ele, e o rei estava sentado inteiramente a sós na sua sala de verão. Disse Eúde: Tenho que dizer-te uma palavra da parte de Deus. O rei levantou-se logo da sua cadeira.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֵהוּד֙ אֶת־ יַ֣ד שְׂמֹאל֔וֹ וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ הַחֶ֔רֶב מֵעַ֖ל יֶ֣רֶךְ יְמִינ֑וֹ וַיִּתְקָעֶ֖הָ בְּבִטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ê·hūḏ ’eṯ- yaḏ śə·mō·lōw way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ mê·‘al ye·reḵ yə·mî·nōw way·yiṯ·qā·‘e·hā bə·ḇiṭ·nōw
verses.literal: And Ehud reached with his left hand pulled the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into Eglon’s belly
verses.literalPt: Então, Eúde, estendendo a mão esquerda, tirou o punhal de sobre a coxa direita e lho cravou no ventre.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א גַֽם־ הַנִּצָּ֜ב אַחַ֣ר הַלַּ֗הַב וַיִּסְגֹּ֤ר הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ בְּעַ֣ד הַלַּ֔הַב כִּ֣י לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ף הַחֶ֖רֶב מִבִּטְנ֑וֹ וַיֵּצֵ֖א הַֽפַּרְשְׁדֹֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḡam- han·niṣ·ṣāḇ ’a·ḥar hal·la·haḇ way·yis·gōr ha·ḥê·leḇ bə·‘aḏ hal·la·haḇ kî lō šā·lap̄ ha·ḥe·reḇ mib·biṭ·nōw way·yê·ṣê hap·par·šə·ḏō·nāh
verses.literal: Even the handle sank in after the blade and Eglon’s fat closed in over it so that Ehud did not withdraw the sword from his belly And Eglon’s bowels emptied
verses.literalPt: O cabo também entrou após a folha, e a gordura fechou-se sobre ela, porque não tirou do ventre o punhal. Saíram as fezes.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א אֵה֖וּד הַֽמִּסְדְּר֑וֹנָה וַיִּסְגֹּ֞ר דַּלְת֧וֹת הָעַלִיָּ֛ה בַּעֲד֖וֹ וְנָעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’ê·hūḏ ham·mis·də·rō·w·nāh way·yis·gōr dal·ṯō·wṯ hā·‘a·lî·yāh ba·‘ă·ḏōw wə·nā·‘āl
verses.literal: Then Ehud went out through the porch closing and locking the doors of the upper room behind him
verses.literalPt: Eúde, saindo ao pórtico, cerrou sobre ele as portas da sala e trancou-as.

verses.original: וְה֤וּא יָצָא֙ וַעֲבָדָ֣יו בָּ֔אוּ וַיִּרְא֕וּ וְהִנֵּ֛ה דַּלְת֥וֹת הָעֲלִיָּ֖ה נְעֻל֑וֹת וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אַ֣ךְ מֵסִ֥יךְ ה֛וּא אֶת־ רַגְלָ֖יו בַּחֲדַ֥ר הַמְּקֵרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū yā·ṣā wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw bā·’ū way·yir·’ū wə·hin·nêh dal·ṯō·wṯ hā·‘ă·lî·yāh nə·‘u·lō·wṯ way·yō·mə·rū ’aḵ mê·sîḵ hū ’eṯ- raḡ·lāw ba·ḥă·ḏar ham·mə·qê·rāh
verses.literal: After Ehud was gone Eglon’s servants came in and found the doors of the upper room locked . . . He must be relieving himself . . . in the cool room they said
verses.literalPt: Depois de ter ele saído, vieram os servos do rei. Olharam, e eis que as portas da sala estavam trancadas. Disseram: Sem dúvida ele está aliviando o ventre na privada do seu quarto.

verses.original: וַיָּחִ֣ילוּ עַד־ בּ֔וֹשׁ וְהְנֵּ֛ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ פֹתֵ֖חַ דַּלְת֣וֹת הָֽעֲלִיָּ֑ה וַיִּקְח֤וּ אֶת־ הַמַּפְתֵּ֙חַ֙ וַיִּפְתָּ֔חוּ וְהִנֵּה֙ אֲדֹ֣נֵיהֶ֔ם נֹפֵ֥ל אַ֖רְצָה מֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥî·lū ‘aḏ- bō·wōš wə·hən·nēh ’ê·nen·nū p̄ō·ṯê·aḥ dal·ṯō·wṯ hå̄·ʿă·lī·yå̄h way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- ham·map̄·tê·aḥ way·yip̄·tā·ḥū wə·hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nê·hem nō·p̄êl ’ar·ṣāh mêṯ
verses.literal: So they waited until they became worried and saw that he had still not opened the doors of the upper room Then they took the key and opened the doors and there was their lord lying dead on the floor
verses.literalPt: Esperaram até que viram que estavam enganados, pois que não abriu as portas da sala; portanto, tomaram a chave e as abriram. Eis que o seu senhor estava estendido morto em terra.

verses.original: וְאֵה֥וּד נִמְלַ֖ט עַ֣ד הִֽתְמַהְמְהָ֑ם וְהוּא֙ עָבַ֣ר אֶת־ הַפְּסִילִ֔ים וַיִּמָּלֵ֖ט הַשְּׂעִירָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·hūḏ nim·laṭ ‘aḏ hiṯ·mah·mə·hām wə·hū ‘ā·ḇar ’eṯ- hap·pə·sî·lîm way·yim·mā·lêṭ haś·śə·‘î·rā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Ehud, however had escaped while the servants waited He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah
verses.literalPt: Eúde escapou enquanto se demoravam e, tendo passado pelas pedras esculpidas, foi para Seirá.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹא֔וֹ וַיִּתְקַ֥ע בַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּרְד֨וּ עִמּ֧וֹ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִן־ הָהָ֖ר וְה֥וּא לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ḇō·w·’ōw way·yiṯ·qa‘ baš·šō·w·p̄ār bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim way·yê·rə·ḏū ‘im·mōw ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl min- hā·hār wə·hū lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: On arriving in Seirah he blew the ram’s horn throughout the hill country of Ephraim The Israelites . . . came down with him from the hills and he became their leader . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois de ter chegado, tocou na trombeta o alarme na região montanhosa de Efraim, e os filhos de Israel, com ele à frente, desceram dali.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ רִדְפ֣וּ אַחֲרַ֔י כִּֽי־ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם אֶת־ מוֹאָ֖ב בְּיֶדְכֶ֑ם וַיֵּרְד֣וּ אַחֲרָ֗יו וַֽיִּלְכְּד֞וּ אֶת־ מַעְבְּר֤וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לְמוֹאָ֔ב וְלֹֽא־ נָתְנ֥וּ אִ֖ישׁ לַעֲבֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem riḏ·p̄ū ’a·ḥă·ray kî- nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ bə·yeḏ·ḵem way·yê·rə·ḏū ’a·ḥă·rāw way·yil·kə·ḏū ’eṯ- ma‘·bə·rō·wṯ hay·yar·dên lə·mō·w·’āḇ wə·lō- nā·ṯə·nū ’îš la·‘ă·ḇōr
verses.literal: Follow me he told them . . . for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand So they followed him down . . . and seized the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab and they did not allow anyone to cross over
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes: Segui-me, porque Jeová vos entregou nas mãos os vossos inimigos, os moabitas. Desceram após ele, apoderaram-se dos vaus do Jordão contra os moabitas, e não deixaram passar nem um só homem.

verses.original: וַיַּכּ֨וּ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֜ב בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא כַּעֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ אִ֔ישׁ כָּל־ שָׁמֵ֖ן וְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑יִל וְלֹ֥א נִמְלַ֖ט אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kū ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ bā·‘êṯ ha·hî ka·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’îš kāl- šā·mên wə·ḵāl ’îš ḥā·yil wə·lō nim·laṭ ’îš
verses.literal: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites all robust and valiant men Not one of them escaped . . .
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo, feriram dos moabitas uns dez mil homens, cada um deles robusto e valente; e não escapou nem sequer um.

verses.original: וַתִּכָּנַ֤ע מוֹאָב֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא תַּ֖חַת יַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tik·kā·na‘ mō·w·’āḇ bay·yō·wm ha·hū ta·ḥaṯ yaḏ yiś·rā·’êl wat·tiš·qōṭ hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mō·w·nîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: So Moab was subdued under the hand of Israel that day and the land had rest for eighty years
verses.literalPt: Assim, foi subjugado Moabe, naquele dia, debaixo da mão de Israel. A terra teve descanso oitenta anos.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֤יו הָיָה֙ שַׁמְגַּ֣ר בֶּן־ עֲנָ֔ת וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ שֵֽׁשׁ־ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֔ישׁ בְּמַלְמַ֖ד הַבָּקָ֑ר וַיֹּ֥שַׁע גַּם־ ה֖וּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rāw hā·yāh šam·gar ben- ‘ă·nāṯ way·yaḵ ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš bə·mal·maḏ hab·bā·qār way·yō·ša‘ gam- hū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath And he too saved . . . Israel striking down six hundred . . . Philistines with an oxgoad . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois dele foi Sangar, filho de Anate, que matou a seiscentos homens dos filisteus com uma aguilhada de boi; também ele livrou a Israel.
